scope_note: Full scope is 20 actives, 200 property-matched decoys, 3 Vina seeds per compound. This run used 20 actives, 20 decoys, 1 seed(s). AUC confidence intervals are correspondingly wider and enrichment estimates noisier.
note: Controls confirm that the protocol can discriminate DDR1 actives from property-matched decoys. They do NOT validate the absolute tier thresholds.
